selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'const { spawnSync } = require(`node:child_process`); const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `guide-`)); fs.cpSync(`examples`, path.join(tmp, `examples`), { recursive: true }); const bin = path.resolve(`bin/records-export.js`); const run = (...args) => spawnSync(process.execPath, [bin, ...args], { cwd: tmp, encoding: `utf8` }); const q = String.fromCharCode(34); const crlf = String.fromCharCode(13, 10); const lf = String.fromCharCode(10); const rows = (lines) => lines.map((line) => line + crlf).join(``); const lease = q + `Lease agreement, Building B` + q; const prio = q + `Q2 ` + q + q + `priority` + q + q + ` accounts review` + q; const all = rows([`id,title,owner,status`, `1,` + lease + `,dana,active`, `2,Vendor onboarding checklist,li,active`, `3,` + prio + `,dana,archived`]); const cols = rows([`id,title`, `1,` + lease, `2,Vendor onboarding checklist`, `3,` + prio]); const semi = rows([`id;title;owner;status`, `1;Lease agreement, Building B;dana;active`, `2;Vendor onboarding checklist;li;active`, `3;` + prio + `;dana;archived`]); const fail = (n, r) => { console.error(n, r.status, r.stdout, r.stderr); process.exit(n); }; let r = run(`examples/records.json`); if (r.status !== 0 || r.stdout !== all) fail(1, r); r = run(`examples/records.json`, `--columns`, `id,title`); if (r.status !== 0 || r.stdout !== cols) fail(2, r); r = run(`examples/records.json`, `--output`, `records.csv`); if (r.status !== 0 || r.stdout !== `` || r.stderr !== `records-export: wrote 3 records to records.csv` + lf || fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp, `records.csv`), `utf8`) !== all) fail(3, r); r = run(`examples/records.json`, `--delimiter`, `;`); if (r.status !== 0 || r.stdout !== semi) fail(4, r); r = run(`--input`, `examples/records.json`); if (r.status !== 2 || !r.stderr.startsWith(`records-export: unknown option: --input`)) fail(5, r); r = run(`missing.json`); if (r.status !== 1) fail(6, r); r = run(`examples/records.json`, `--delimiter`, `||`); if (r.status !== 2) fail(7, r); r = run(`--version`); if (r.status !== 0 || r.stdout !== `1.2.0` + lf) fail(8, r); r = run(`-h`); if (r.status !== 0 || !r.stdout.startsWith(`Usage: records-export <input.json>`)) fail(9, r); console.log(`documented examples hold`);'

notes: Standalone fixture (the suggested export-synchronizing base changes source code, which contradicts a documentation-only cycle). Pre-install: 50-cli commits a small Node ESM command records-export (bin/records-export.js, src/cli.js with parseArgs/USAGE/run, src/csv.js with RFC 4180 quoting, 11 node:test tests, .gitignore with node_modules and *.csv); 52-guide adds README.md, examples/records.json, and docs/cli.md whose examples use --input, --out, -d, and a space-separated column list, none of which the command accepts. Then the brownfield install. Post-install layers follow the standard brownfield order for cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2: 60 context (STATE SCOPING), 62 scope with one condition AC-001 (examples run as written and match the command; STATE ARCHITECTING), 64 design with AC-001 No architectural impact (STATE DEVELOPING), 66 a COMPLETE development plan with no build steps (Plan Notes explain why; STATE TESTING), 68 COMPLETE FULL verification with AC-001 pending Documenter and npm test as regression evidence (STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION), 70 COMPLETE implementation review, no findings, AC-001 permitted dependency (STATE DOCUMENTING), 72 the corrected docs/cli.md (only project file changed in the cycle), 74 COMPLETE documentation record whose checks run every example and inspect options/exit status against src/cli.js (STATE REVIEWING_FINAL), 76 COMPLETE final-deliverable review re-running the examples (STATE SYNCHRONIZING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_FINAL). Records cite revisions and contents with COMMIT/BLOB placeholders, all equal to HEAD. No synchronization record exists; tree clean; check passes.
